opportunities.title: No published speech recognition error rate
opportunities.detail: The language isn't in the published FLEURS error-rate breakdowns we track, so builders can't tell how usable open speech recognition is.
opportunities.why: About 12 million Yoruba speakers are online today, and that should reach 16 million within five years. Ready to use: NaijaVoices (607 hours of transcribed speech); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No cloud text-to-speech voice found, though open resources exist
opportunities.detail: None of the cloud services checked has a voice for this language. An open text-to-speech model already speaks it. Open datasets hold 627 hours of transcribed speech.
opportunities.why: About 12 million Yoruba speakers are online today, and that should reach 16 million within five years. Ready to use: MMS text-to-speech (covers this language); NaijaVoices (607 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: An open text recognition model exists, but no major service
opportunities.detail: An open OCR model reads printed text in this language. Text recognition also turns printed books into training data for every other technology.
opportunities.why: About 7.9 million Yoruba speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 11 million within five years. Ready to use: Tesseract OCR (covers this language); FineWeb-2 (59 million words).
